name: motion-drawer-default
title: Motion Drawer Default
blurb: Pre-configured side drawer with default theme and animations.
description: A ready-to-use motion drawer with theme-aware colors and default spring animation. Includes toggle button, overlay, and drag-to-close. No setup required beyond adding content.
use_when: You need a navigation drawer immediately without tuning dimensions or animations.
avoid_when: Your design requires custom drawer width or specific animation timing.
a11y: Click and overlay close are supported. No additional focus management beyond base drawer component.
